questions.q: Describe the main features of the imperial capital of Vijayanagara.
answer: Vijayanagara, meaning the city of victory, was the magnificent capital of the empire of the same name, founded in 1336 on the banks of the Tungabhadra, at the site now called Hampi.

answer.text: The city was protected by massive stone walls and gateways enclosing not only the town but also its farmland. To supply so large a population, elaborate arrangements were made for water, including the great Kamalapuram tank and the Hiriya canal for irrigation.
The royal centre held the audience halls and the raised Mahanavami Dibba, from which the king watched the grand Mahanavami festival, along with the elegant Lotus Mahal and the elephant stables.
The sacred centre had splendid temples such as the Virupaksha and the Vitthala, the latter famous for its stone chariot and musical pillars, with towering gateways called gopurams.

answer: The ruins at Hampi still reflect the wealth and artistry of this great capital.

questions.q: How was the Vijayanagara Empire governed and defended?

answer.text: in south India was a powerful state that was strongly governed and heavily defended.

list: The king was the supreme authority, aided by ministers and a large administration
The empire was divided into provinces under governors (nayakas) who held land in return for military service

answer.text: The capital and empire were well protected.

list: The capital was ringed by massive fortifications and its water supply carefully secured
The empire maintained a large army with cavalry and war elephants, and its long rivalry with the Deccan Sultanates shaped its history

questions.q: How do the ruins of Hampi reveal the grandeur of Vijayanagara?

answer.text: the site of Vijayanagara, still show the grandeur of the once-great capital, and were rediscovered and studied by archaeologists.

list: Grand temples like the Virupaksha and Vitthala temples, with their carved pillars and halls, show its wealth and devotion
The royal centre had palaces, audience halls, and structures like the Lotus Mahal and elephant stables

answer.lead: The layout speaks of a rich city.
answer.text: It combined the sacred and the royal.

list: Markets, water tanks and canals reveal a large, well-planned urban life
The scale and splendour of the ruins bear out foreign travellers' descriptions of a magnificent city
